name: Spectrum SBS480CBV 40V Cordless Leaf Blower Vacuum 3-in-1 Kit with 4.0Ah Battery and Standard Charger
Body Copy:
Clear leaves, mow clippings and garden debris in one cordless tool that switches between blow, vacuum and mulch as you work. The Spectrum SBS480CBV Complete Kit arrives with the 3-in-1 blower vacuum, a 40V 4.0Ah lithium-ion battery and a standard charger - ready to use straight out of the box.

In blow mode, 52m/s airflow shifts wet leaves off paths, patios and lawn edges. Switch to vacuum mode and the air volume climbs to 588 cubic metres per hour, drawing debris into the 12-litre collection bag while a 3-blade mulching system shreds the load at a 30:1 ratio. One bag fills slowly enough for fewer trips to the compost heap.

At 4.26kg with an adjustable handle, longer tidying sessions stay comfortable. The included 4.0Ah pack uses high-grade 21700 cells for steady voltage under load and shares with every other tool in the Spectrum 40V range. Backed by a 5-year manufacturer warranty.
Unique Selling Point 01: Three-in-one cordless tool: blow, vacuum and mulch in a single body
Unique Selling Point 02: 52m/s air speed shifts wet leaves and stubborn debris in blow mode
Unique Selling Point 03: 588 cubic metres per hour vacuum air volume for fast, efficient pickup
Unique Selling Point 04: 30:1 mulching ratio compresses a bag of leaves to a fraction of its volume
Unique Selling Point 05: 12-litre collection bag stays manageable on long tidying sessions
Unique Selling Point 06: Adjustable handle keeps the tool comfortable through longer use
Unique Selling Point 07: Just 4.26kg - far less tiring than a comparable petrol blower vac
Unique Selling Point 08: Backed by a 5-year Spectrum manufacturer warranty (T&Cs apply)
Selling Copy: Three-in-one cordless tool that blows, vacuums and mulches leaves and garden debris. Kit ships with a 40V 4.0Ah lithium-ion battery and a standard charger, so it is ready to work as soon as it arrives. Part of the Spectrum 40V cordless range - one battery system, every garden tool.
Tech_Included: Spectrum SBS480CBV blower vacuum, Spectrum SBS40CB 40V 4.0Ah lithium-ion battery, Spectrum SBSCBC standard charger
Guarantee_specifics: Years 1 to 2 full parts and labour cover. Years 3 to 5 parts-only cover. Subject to annual servicing and proof of purchase. Domestic use only.
